Instruction = Struct.new(:op, :args, :position)
Label = Struct.new(:position)
Unit = Struct.new(:name, :function, :slots, :before, :after, :blocks, :depth, :recursive, :before_start, :after_start)
module Bytecode
  BINARY = { '+' => 'ADD', '-' => 'SUB', '*' => 'MUL', '/' => 'DIV', '%' => 'MOD',
             '<' => 'LT', '<=' => 'LE', '>' => 'GT', '>=' => 'GE', '==' => 'EQ', '!=' => 'NE' }.freeze
  JUMPS = %w[JUMP JUMPF JUMPT].freeze
  CONDITIONAL = %w[JUMPF JUMPT].freeze
  TRANSFERS = %w[JUMP RET RETV HALT].freeze
  NEGATED = { 'LT' => 'GE', 'LE' => 'GT', 'GT' => 'LE', 'GE' => 'LT', 'EQ' => 'NE', 'NE' => 'EQ' }.freeze
  INVERSE = { 'JUMPF' => 'JUMPT', 'JUMPT' => 'JUMPF' }.freeze
end
class Generator
  include Bytecode
  def initialize
    @code, @loops = [], []
  end
  def emit(op, position, *args) = @code << Instruction.new(op, args, position)
  def mark(label) = label.position = @code.length
  def finish
    @code.map do |instruction|
      args = JUMPS.include?(instruction.op) ? [instruction.args[0].position] : instruction.args
      Instruction.new(instruction.op, args, instruction.position)
    end
  end
  def expression(node) = generate_tree(:expression, node)
  def statement(node) = generate_tree(:statement, node)
  def instruction(op, position, *args) = [:emit, op, position, *args]
  def generate_tree(kind, root)
    pending = [[kind, root]]
    until pending.empty?
      action, *arguments = pending.pop
      case action
      when :emit then emit(*arguments)
      when :mark then mark(arguments[0])
      when :loop then @loops << arguments
      when :end_loop then @loops.pop
      else
        tasks = action == :expression ? expression_tasks(arguments[0]) : statement_tasks(arguments[0])
        pending.concat(tasks.reverse)
      end
    end
  end
  def expression_tasks(node)
    position = node.position
    case node.kind
    when 'integer' then [instruction('PUSH', position, node.value)]
    when 'boolean' then [instruction('PUSH', position, node.value ? 1 : 0)]
    when 'variable'
      referent = node.referent
      [instruction(referent.kind == 'global' ? 'LOADG' : 'LOADL', position, referent.kind == 'global' ? referent.address : referent.slot)]
    when 'array'
      [[:expression, node.index], instruction('LOADA', position, node.referent.address, node.referent.size)]
    when 'read' then [instruction('READ', position)]
    when 'call'
      node.arguments.map { |argument| [:expression, argument] } + [instruction('CALL', position, node.referent.name, node.arguments.length)]
    when 'unary'
      [[:expression, node.operand], instruction(node.operator == '-' ? 'NEG' : 'NOT', position)]
    when 'binary'
      if %w[&& ||].include?(node.operator)
        shortcut, ending = Label.new, Label.new
        [[:expression, node.left], instruction(node.operator == '&&' ? 'JUMPF' : 'JUMPT', position, shortcut),
         [:expression, node.right], instruction('JUMP', position, ending), [:mark, shortcut],
         instruction('PUSH', position, node.operator == '||' ? 1 : 0), [:mark, ending]]
      else
        [[:expression, node.left], [:expression, node.right], instruction(BINARY.fetch(node.operator), position)]
      end
    end
  end
  def statement_tasks(node)
    position = node.position
    case node.kind
    when 'declaration'
      [node.initializer ? [:expression, node.initializer] : instruction('PUSH', node.name_position, 0),
       instruction('STOREL', node.name_position, node.slot)]
    when 'assignment'
      tasks = node.index ? [[:expression, node.index]] : []
      tasks << [:expression, node.value]
      referent = node.referent
      if node.index
        tasks << instruction('STOREA', position, referent.address, referent.size)
      elsif referent.kind == 'global'
        tasks << instruction('STOREG', position, referent.address)
      else
        tasks << instruction('STOREL', position, referent.slot)
      end
      tasks
    when 'call_statement'
      tasks = [[:expression, node.expression]]
      tasks << instruction('POP', position) unless node.expression.type == 'void'
      tasks
    when 'print'
      node.arguments.map { |argument| [:expression, argument] } + [instruction('PRINT', position, node.arguments.length)]
    when 'if'
      alternative, ending = Label.new, Label.new
      tasks = [[:expression, node.condition], instruction('JUMPF', position, alternative), [:statement, node.then_branch]]
      if node.otherwise
        tasks.concat([instruction('JUMP', position, ending), [:mark, alternative], [:statement, node.otherwise], [:mark, ending]])
      else
        tasks << [:mark, alternative]
      end
      tasks
    when 'while'
      start, ending = Label.new, Label.new
      [[:mark, start], [:expression, node.condition], instruction('JUMPF', position, ending),
       [:loop, ending, start], [:statement, node.body], [:end_loop], instruction('JUMP', position, start), [:mark, ending]]
    when 'for'
      start, update, ending = Label.new, Label.new, Label.new
      tasks = node.initial ? [[:statement, node.initial]] : []
      tasks << [:mark, start]
      if node.condition
        tasks.concat([[:expression, node.condition], instruction('JUMPF', position, ending)])
      end
      tasks.concat([[:loop, ending, update], [:statement, node.body], [:end_loop], [:mark, update]])
      tasks << [:statement, node.update] if node.update
      tasks.concat([instruction('JUMP', position, start), [:mark, ending]])
    when 'break', 'continue' then [instruction('JUMP', position, @loops.last[node.kind == 'continue' ? 1 : 0])]
    when 'return'
      tasks = node.value ? [[:expression, node.value]] : []
      tasks << instruction(node.value ? 'RETV' : 'RET', position)
    when 'block' then node.statements.map { |child| [:statement, child] }
    else []
    end
  end
  def self.assign_slots(function)
    declarations, pending = [], [function.body]
    until pending.empty?
      node = pending.pop
      declarations << node if node.kind == 'declaration'
      pending.concat(Tree.statement_children(node))
    end
    slots = function.parameters + declarations.sort_by(&:name_position)
    slots.each_with_index { |declaration, index| declaration.slot = index }
    slots
  end
  def self.generate(globals, functions, main)
    address = 0
    globals.each do |variable|
      variable.address = address
      address += variable.size || 1
    end
    initialization = new
    globals.each do |variable|
      next unless variable.initializer
      initialization.expression(variable.initializer)
      initialization.emit('STOREG', variable.name_position, variable.address)
    end
    initialization.emit('CALL', main.name_position, 'main', 0)
    initialization.emit('HALT', main.name_position)
    units = [Unit.new('<init>', nil, [], initialization.finish)]
    functions.each do |function|
      slots = assign_slots(function)
      generator = new
      generator.emit('ENTER', function.name_position, slots.length)
      generator.statement(function.body)
      generator.emit('RET', function.body.end_position) if function.type == 'void'
      units << Unit.new(function.name, function, slots, generator.finish)
    end
    [units, address]
  end
end

Token = Struct.new(:kind, :spelling, :position)
class CompileError < StandardError
  attr_reader :kind, :position
  def initialize(kind, position, message)
    @kind, @position = kind, position
    super(message)
  end
end
module Lexer
  KEYWORDS = %w[int bool void true false if else while for break continue return print read].freeze
  DOUBLE = %w[<= >= == != && ||].freeze
  SINGLE = '+-*/%<>=!(){}[],;'
  def self.tokenize(lines)
    source = lines.map { |_, line| line + "\n" }.join
    index, row, column = 0, lines.first[0], 1
    tokens = []
    while index < source.length
      start = index
      position = [row, column]
      character = source[index]
      kind = nil
      if " \n".include?(character)
        index += 1
      elsif source[index, 2] == '//'
        index = source.index("\n", index)
      elsif source[index, 2] == '/*'
        closing = source.index('*/', index + 2)
        raise CompileError.new('lexical', position, 'unterminated comment') unless closing
        index = closing + 2
      elsif character.match?(/[A-Za-z_]/)
        index += 1
        index += 1 while index < source.length && source[index].match?(/[A-Za-z0-9_]/)
        kind = KEYWORDS.include?(source[start...index]) ? 'keyword' : 'identifier'
      elsif character.match?(/[0-9]/)
        index += 1 while index < source.length && source[index].match?(/[0-9]/)
        if source[start...index].to_i > 2_147_483_647
          raise CompileError.new('lexical', position, 'integer literal too large')
        end
        kind = 'integer'
      elsif DOUBLE.include?(source[index, 2])
        index += 2
        kind = 'symbol'
      elsif SINGLE.include?(character)
        index += 1
        kind = 'symbol'
      else
        raise CompileError.new('lexical', position, "unexpected character '#{character}'")
      end
      consumed = source[start...index]
      tokens << Token.new(kind, consumed, position) if kind
      if consumed.include?("\n")
        row += consumed.count("\n")
        column = consumed.length - consumed.rindex("\n")
      else
        column += consumed.length
      end
    end
    tokens << Token.new('end', '', [lines.last[0], lines.last[1].length + 1])
  end
end

require_relative 'lexer'
require_relative 'parser'
require_relative 'semantic'
require_relative 'codegen'
require_relative 'vm'

RULES = %w[const-jump not-compare not-jump invert-branch thread jump-next unreachable].freeze
PUSHING = %w[PUSH LOADG LOADL READ].freeze
POPPING = %w[POP STOREG STOREL JUMPF JUMPT RETV ADD SUB MUL DIV MOD LT LE GT GE EQ NE].freeze
REPORTS = %w[listing.txt output.txt diagnostics.txt stats.txt].freeze

def collect_warnings(analysis)
  warnings = analysis.variables.filter_map do |variable|
    role = variable.kind == 'parameter' ? 'parameter' : 'variable'
    [variable.name_position, "unused #{role} '#{variable.name}'"] if variable.read_accesses.zero?
  end
  analysis.functions.each do |function|
    pending = [function.body]
    until pending.empty?
      statement = pending.pop
      if statement.kind == 'block'
        statement.statements.each_cons(2) do |first, following|
          unless can_complete?(first)
            warnings << [following.position, 'unreachable statement']
            break
          end
        end
      end
      pending.concat(Tree.statement_children(statement))
    end
  end
  reachable, pending = Set.new, [analysis.globals.fetch('main')]
  until pending.empty?
    function = pending.pop
    next if reachable.include?(function)
    reachable << function
    pending.concat(function.calls.to_a)
  end
  analysis.functions.each do |function|
    warnings << [function.name_position, "function '#{function.name}' is never called"] unless reachable.include?(function)
  end
  [warnings.sort_by(&:first), reachable]
end

def recursive?(function)
  visited, pending = Set.new, function.calls.to_a
  until pending.empty?
    current = pending.pop
    return true if current.equal?(function)
    next if visited.include?(current)
    visited << current
    pending.concat(current.calls.to_a)
  end
  false
end

class Folder
  attr_reader :count
  def initialize = @count = 0
  def literal?(node, kind, value) = node.kind == kind && node.value == value
  def literal(node, value)
    @count += 1
    kind = node.type == 'bool' ? 'boolean' : 'integer'
    value = !value.zero? if kind == 'boolean' && value.is_a?(Integer)
    Node.new(kind, node.position, type: node.type, value: value)
  end
  def identity(node)
    @count += 1
    node
  end
  def as_integer(node) = node.kind == 'boolean' ? (node.value ? 1 : 0) : node.value
  def expression(node)
    folded, pending = {}, [[node, false]]
    until pending.empty?
      current, expanded = pending.pop
      unless expanded
        pending << [current, true]
        Tree.expression_children(current).reverse_each { |child| pending << [child, false] }
        next
      end
      case current.kind
      when 'unary' then current.operand = folded.fetch(current.operand)
      when 'binary' then current.left, current.right = folded.fetch(current.left), folded.fetch(current.right)
      when 'array' then current.index = folded.fetch(current.index)
      when 'call' then current.arguments = current.arguments.map { |argument| folded.fetch(argument) }
      end
      folded[current] = fold_expression(current)
    end
    folded.fetch(node)
  end
  def fold_expression(node)
    case node.kind
    when 'unary'
      if %w[integer boolean].include?(node.operand.kind)
        begin
          value = IntegerOperations.calculate(node.operator == '-' ? 'NEG' : 'NOT', as_integer(node.operand))
          return literal(node, value)
        rescue RuntimeFault
          return node
        end
      end
    when 'binary'
      left, right, operator = node.left, node.right, node.operator
      if %w[integer boolean].include?(left.kind) && %w[integer boolean].include?(right.kind)
        a, b = as_integer(left), as_integer(right)
        begin
          value = case operator
                  when '&&' then !a.zero? && !b.zero?
                  when '||' then !a.zero? || !b.zero?
                  else IntegerOperations.calculate(Bytecode::BINARY.fetch(operator), a, b)
                  end
          return literal(node, value)
        rescue RuntimeFault
        end
      end
      return literal(node, false) if operator == '&&' && literal?(left, 'boolean', false)
      return literal(node, true) if operator == '||' && literal?(left, 'boolean', true)
      return identity(right) if operator == '&&' && literal?(left, 'boolean', true)
      return identity(right) if operator == '||' && literal?(left, 'boolean', false)
      return identity(right) if operator == '+' && literal?(left, 'integer', 0)
      return identity(right) if operator == '*' && literal?(left, 'integer', 1)
      return identity(left) if %w[+ -].include?(operator) && literal?(right, 'integer', 0)
      return identity(left) if %w[* /].include?(operator) && literal?(right, 'integer', 1)
      return identity(left) if operator == '&&' && literal?(right, 'boolean', true)
      return identity(left) if operator == '||' && literal?(right, 'boolean', false)
    end
    node
  end
  def statement(root)
    folded, pending = {}, [[:visit, root]]
    until pending.empty?
      action, node, selected = pending.pop
      if action == :replace
        folded[node] = selected ? folded.fetch(selected) : Node.new('empty', node.position)
        @count += 1
      elsif action == :condition
        node.condition = expression(node.condition) if node.condition
      elsif action == :finish
        case node.kind
        when 'block' then node.statements = node.statements.map { |child| folded.fetch(child) }
        when 'if'
          node.then_branch = folded.fetch(node.then_branch)
          node.otherwise = folded.fetch(node.otherwise) if node.otherwise
        when 'while' then node.body = folded.fetch(node.body)
        when 'for'
          node.initial = folded.fetch(node.initial) if node.initial
          node.update = folded.fetch(node.update) if node.update
          node.body = folded.fetch(node.body)
        end
        folded[node] = node
      else
        case node.kind
        when 'block'
          pending << [:finish, node]
          node.statements.reverse_each { |child| pending << [:visit, child] }
        when 'if'
          node.condition = expression(node.condition)
          if node.condition.kind == 'boolean'
            selected = node.condition.value ? node.then_branch : node.otherwise
            pending << [:replace, node, selected]
            pending << [:visit, selected] if selected
          else
            pending << [:finish, node]
            pending << [:visit, node.otherwise] if node.otherwise
            pending << [:visit, node.then_branch]
          end
        when 'while'
          node.condition = expression(node.condition)
          if literal?(node.condition, 'boolean', false)
            folded[node] = Node.new('empty', node.position)
            @count += 1
          else
            pending << [:finish, node]
            pending << [:visit, node.body]
          end
        when 'for'
          pending << [:finish, node]
          pending << [:visit, node.body]
          pending << [:visit, node.update] if node.update
          pending << [:condition, node]
          pending << [:visit, node.initial] if node.initial
        else
          fold_simple_statement(node)
          folded[node] = node
        end
      end
    end
    folded.fetch(root)
  end
  def fold_simple_statement(node)
    case node.kind
    when 'declaration' then node.initializer = expression(node.initializer) if node.initializer
    when 'assignment'
      node.index = expression(node.index) if node.index
      node.value = expression(node.value)
    when 'call_statement' then node.expression = expression(node.expression)
    when 'print' then node.arguments = node.arguments.map { |argument| expression(argument) }
    when 'return' then node.value = expression(node.value) if node.value
    end
  end
end

def jumps_on?(op, value) = value.zero? == (op == 'JUMPF')
def delete_instruction(code, position)
  code.delete_at(position)
  code.map! do |instruction|
    if Bytecode::JUMPS.include?(instruction.op) && instruction.args[0] > position
      Instruction.new(instruction.op, [instruction.args[0] - 1], instruction.position)
    else
      instruction
    end
  end
end
def rewrite_at(code, index, targets)
  first, second = code[index], code[index + 1]
  free = second && !targets.include?(index + 1)
  if free && first.op == 'PUSH' && Bytecode::CONDITIONAL.include?(second.op)
    if jumps_on?(second.op, first.args[0])
      code[index] = Instruction.new('JUMP', second.args, second.position)
      delete_instruction(code, index + 1)
    else
      delete_instruction(code, index + 1)
      delete_instruction(code, index)
    end
    return 1
  end
  if free && Bytecode::NEGATED.key?(first.op) && second.op == 'NOT'
    code[index] = Instruction.new(Bytecode::NEGATED.fetch(first.op), first.args, first.position)
    delete_instruction(code, index + 1)
    return 2
  end
  if free && first.op == 'NOT' && Bytecode::CONDITIONAL.include?(second.op)
    code[index] = Instruction.new(Bytecode::INVERSE.fetch(second.op), second.args, second.position)
    delete_instruction(code, index + 1)
    return 3
  end
  if free && Bytecode::CONDITIONAL.include?(first.op) && first.args[0] == index + 2 && second.op == 'JUMP'
    code[index] = Instruction.new(Bytecode::INVERSE.fetch(first.op), second.args, first.position)
    delete_instruction(code, index + 1)
    return 4
  end
  if Bytecode::JUMPS.include?(first.op)
    target = first.args[0]
    if target < code.length
      destination = code[target]
      new_target = nil
      if destination.op == 'JUMP'
        new_target = destination.args[0]
      elsif destination.op == 'PUSH' && target + 1 < code.length
        following = code[target + 1]
        if Bytecode::CONDITIONAL.include?(following.op)
          new_target = jumps_on?(following.op, destination.args[0]) ? following.args[0] : target + 2
        end
      end
      if new_target && new_target != target
        code[index] = Instruction.new(first.op, [new_target], first.position)
        return 5
      end
    end
    if target == index + 1
      if first.op == 'JUMP'
        delete_instruction(code, index)
      else
        code[index] = Instruction.new('POP', [], first.position)
      end
      return 6
    end
  end
  if free && Bytecode::TRANSFERS.include?(first.op)
    delete_instruction(code, index + 1)
    return 7
  end
  0
end
def optimize(original)
  code, counts = original.dup, Array.new(RULES.length, 0)
  loop do
    targets = code.filter_map { |instruction| instruction.args[0] if Bytecode::JUMPS.include?(instruction.op) }.to_set
    applied = false
    code.each_index do |index|
      rule = rewrite_at(code, index, targets)
      next if rule.zero?
      counts[rule - 1] += 1
      applied = true
      break
    end
    return [code, counts] unless applied
  end
end

def successors(code, index)
  instruction = code[index]
  result = []
  result << index + 1 if !Bytecode::TRANSFERS.include?(instruction.op) && index + 1 < code.length
  if Bytecode::JUMPS.include?(instruction.op)
    target = instruction.args[0]
    result << target if target < code.length && !result.include?(target)
  end
  result
end
def stack_effect(instruction, functions)
  op, args = instruction.op, instruction.args
  return 1 if PUSHING.include?(op)
  return -1 if POPPING.include?(op)
  return -2 if op == 'STOREA'
  return -args[1] + (functions.fetch(args[0]).type == 'void' ? 0 : 1) if op == 'CALL'
  return -args[0] if op == 'PRINT'
  0
end
def analyze_flow(unit, functions)
  code, leaders = unit.after, Set[0]
  code.each_with_index do |instruction, index|
    leaders << instruction.args[0] if Bytecode::JUMPS.include?(instruction.op) && instruction.args[0] < code.length
    if (Bytecode::JUMPS.include?(instruction.op) || Bytecode::TRANSFERS.include?(instruction.op)) && index + 1 < code.length
      leaders << index + 1
    end
  end
  starts = leaders.sort
  block_numbers = starts.each_with_index.to_h
  unit.blocks = starts.each_with_index.map do |start, number|
    ending = number + 1 < starts.length ? starts[number + 1] - 1 : code.length - 1
    [start, ending, successors(code, ending).map { |target| block_numbers.fetch(target) }]
  end
  depths, pending, maximum = { 0 => 0 }, [0], 0
  until pending.empty?
    index = pending.pop
    after = depths[index] + stack_effect(code[index], functions)
    maximum = [maximum, after].max
    successors(code, index).each do |target|
      next if depths.key?(target)
      depths[target] = after
      pending << target
    end
  end
  unit.depth = maximum
end
def link_units(units, version)
  addresses, offset = {}, 0
  units.each do |unit|
    addresses[unit.name] = offset
    unit.public_send("#{version}_start=", offset)
    offset += unit.public_send(version).length
  end
  code, owners = [], []
  units.each do |unit|
    unit.public_send(version).each do |instruction|
      args = instruction.args
      if Bytecode::JUMPS.include?(instruction.op)
        args = [addresses.fetch(unit.name) + args[0]]
      elsif instruction.op == 'CALL'
        args = [addresses.fetch(args[0]), args[1]]
      end
      code << Instruction.new(instruction.op, args, instruction.position)
      owners << unit.name
    end
  end
  [code, owners, addresses.invert]
end

class Program
  attr_accessor :inputs
  attr_reader :name, :lines, :source_text, :error, :warnings, :analysis, :globals, :units,
              :folds, :peephole, :before, :after, :owners, :execution, :comparison
  def initialize(name)
    @name, @lines, @inputs = name, [], []
    @error = nil
    @warnings, @folds, @peephole = [], 0, Array.new(RULES.length, 0)
  end
  def compile
    @source_text = @lines.to_h
    begin
      tokens = Lexer.tokenize(@lines)
      declarations = Parser.new(tokens).parse
      @analysis = Analyzer.new(declarations, tokens.last.position).analyze
    rescue CompileError => error
      @error = error
      return
    end
    @warnings, reachable = collect_warnings(@analysis)
    @globals = declarations.select { |node| node.kind == 'global' }
    functions = @analysis.functions.select { |function| reachable.include?(function) }
    folder = Folder.new
    @globals.each { |variable| variable.initializer = folder.expression(variable.initializer) if variable.initializer }
    functions.each { |function| function.body = folder.statement(function.body) }
    @folds = folder.count
    @units, global_size = Generator.generate(@globals, functions, @analysis.globals.fetch('main'))
    function_table = functions.to_h { |function| [function.name, function] }
    @units.each do |unit|
      unit.after, counts = optimize(unit.before)
      counts.each_with_index { |count, index| @peephole[index] += count }
      analyze_flow(unit, function_table)
      unit.recursive = unit.function && recursive?(unit.function)
    end
    @before, before_owners, before_starts = link_units(@units, 'before')
    @after, @owners, after_starts = link_units(@units, 'after')
    @execution = Execution.new(@after, @owners, after_starts, global_size, @inputs).run
    @comparison = Execution.new(@before, before_owners, before_starts, global_size, @inputs).run
  end
end

def spelling(instruction) = ([instruction.op] + instruction.args).join(' ')
def format_position(position) = position.join(':')
def position_display(program, position)
  line, column = position
  ['  ' + program.source_text.fetch(line), ' ' * (column + 1) + '^']
end
def listing(program)
  lines = []
  if program.globals.empty?
    lines << 'globals: none'
  else
    lines << 'globals:'
    program.globals.each do |variable|
      type = variable.size ? "int[#{variable.size}]" : variable.type
      lines << "  #{variable.address} #{variable.name} #{type}"
    end
  end
  lines << 'functions:'
  program.units.each do |unit|
    signature, callees = '', 'main'
    if unit.function
      signature = " #{unit.function.type}(#{unit.function.parameters.map(&:type).join(',')})"
      names = unit.function.calls.map(&:name).sort
      callees = names.empty? ? '-' : names.join(',')
    end
    line = "  #{unit.name}#{signature} address=#{unit.before_start}->#{unit.after_start}"
    line += " size=#{unit.before.length}->#{unit.after.length} slots=#{unit.slots.length}"
    line += " stack=#{unit.depth} blocks=#{unit.blocks.length} calls=#{callees}"
    line += ' recursive' if unit.recursive
    lines << line
    unit.slots.each_with_index { |slot, number| lines << "    slot #{number} #{slot.name} #{slot.type}" }
  end
  lines << 'references:'
  (program.globals + program.analysis.functions).each do |declaration|
    used = declaration.references.map(&:first).uniq.sort
    lines << "  #{declaration.name} defined #{declaration.name_position[0]} used #{used.empty? ? '-' : used.join(' ')}"
  end
  %w[before after].each do |version|
    code = program.public_send(version)
    lines << "#{version} peephole: #{code.length} instructions"
    program.units.each do |unit|
      lines << unit.name + ':'
      start = unit.public_send("#{version}_start")
      unit.public_send(version).length.times do |index|
        address = start + index
        lines << format('%5d  %s', address, spelling(code[address]))
      end
    end
  end
  lines << 'control flow:'
  program.units.each do |unit|
    lines << '  ' + unit.name
    unit.blocks.each_with_index do |(start, ending, following), number|
      line = "    B#{number} #{unit.after_start + start}-#{unit.after_start + ending}"
      line += ' -> ' + following.map { |target| "B#{target}" }.join(' ') unless following.empty?
      lines << line
    end
  end
  lines
end
def diagnostics(program)
  if program.error
    error = program.error
    return ["#{error.kind} error #{format_position(error.position)}: #{error.message}",
            *position_display(program, error.position), 'status: compile error']
  end
  lines = program.warnings.map { |position, message| "warning #{format_position(position)}: #{message}" }
  execution = program.execution
  unless execution.error
    return lines + ['status: ok']
  end
  instruction = program.after[execution.error_pc]
  owner = program.owners[execution.error_pc]
  lines << "runtime error #{format_position(instruction.position)}: #{execution.error} in #{owner}"
  lines.concat(position_display(program, instruction.position))
  callers = execution.frames.drop(1).reverse
  callers.first(5).each do |frame|
    address = frame.return_address - 1
    lines << "  called from #{program.owners[address]} at #{format_position(program.after[address].position)}"
  end
  lines << "  ... #{callers.length - 5} more" if callers.length > 5
  lines << 'status: runtime error'
end
def statistics(program)
  execution, comparison = program.execution, program.comparison
  same = execution.output == comparison.output && execution.error == comparison.error
  lines = ["code: #{program.before.length} -> #{program.after.length}", "folds: #{program.folds}", "peephole: #{program.peephole.sum}"]
  RULES.zip(program.peephole) { |rule, count| lines << "  #{rule} #{count}" }
  lines << "executed: #{execution.executed}"
  lines << "executed before peephole: #{comparison.executed}"
  lines << "behaviour: #{same ? 'same' : 'different'}"
  lines << "max call depth: #{execution.max_depth}"
  lines << "max stack: #{execution.max_stack}"
  opcodes, functions, source_lines = Hash.new(0), Hash.new(0), Hash.new(0)
  program.after.each_with_index do |instruction, address|
    count = execution.counts[address]
    opcodes[instruction.op] += count
    functions[program.owners[address]] += count
    source_lines[instruction.position[0]] += count
  end
  lines << 'opcodes:'
  opcodes.sort_by { |op, count| [-count, op] }.each { |op, count| lines << "  #{op} #{count}" if count.positive? }
  lines << 'functions:'
  names = program.units.select(&:function).map(&:name).sort_by { |name| [-functions[name], name] }
  names.each { |name| lines << "  #{name} calls=#{execution.calls[name]} executed=#{functions[name]}" }
  lines << 'calls:'
  execution.pairs.sort_by { |(caller, callee), count| [-count, caller, callee] }.each do |(caller, callee), count|
    lines << "  #{caller} -> #{callee} #{count}"
  end
  lines << 'hot lines:'
  executed_lines = source_lines.select { |_, count| count.positive? }.sort_by { |line, count| [-count, line] }
  executed_lines.first(5).each { |line, count| lines << "  line #{line}: #{count}" }
  lines << "coverage: #{executed_lines.length} of #{source_lines.length} lines"
  unexecuted = source_lines.select { |_, count| count.zero? }.keys.sort
  lines << 'not executed: ' + (unexecuted.empty? ? 'none' : unexecuted.join(' '))
  lines << 'hot spots:'
  hot_spots = execution.counts.each_with_index.filter_map { |count, address| [address, count] if count.positive? }
  hot_spots.sort_by { |address, count| [-count, address] }.first(5).each do |address, count|
    lines << "  pc=#{address} count=#{count} #{spelling(program.after[address])}"
  end
  lines
end
def summary(programs)
  compiled = programs.reject(&:error)
  errors = Hash.new(0)
  programs.each { |program| errors[program.error.kind] += 1 if program.error }
  peephole = RULES.each_index.map { |index| compiled.sum { |program| program.peephole[index] } }
  lines = ['== summary ==', "programs: #{programs.length}", "compiled: #{compiled.length}"]
  lines << "compile errors: lexical #{errors['lexical']} syntax #{errors['syntax']} semantic #{errors['semantic']}"
  lines << "runtime errors: #{compiled.count { |program| program.execution.error }}"
  lines << "folds: #{compiled.sum(&:folds)}"
  lines << "peephole: #{peephole.sum}"
  RULES.zip(peephole) { |rule, count| lines << "  #{rule} #{count}" }
  lines << "executed: #{compiled.sum { |program| program.execution.executed }}"
  rows = [%w[program status code executed output]]
  programs.each do |program|
    rows << if program.error
              [program.name, program.error.kind + ' error', '-', '-', '-']
            else
              execution = program.execution
              [program.name, execution.error ? 'runtime error' : 'ok', program.after.length.to_s,
               execution.executed.to_s, execution.output.length.to_s]
            end
  end
  widths = (0...5).map { |column| rows.map { |row| row[column].length }.max }
  rows.each do |row|
    fields = row.each_with_index.map { |value, index| index < 2 ? value.ljust(widths[index]) : value.rjust(widths[index]) }
    lines << '  ' + fields.join('  ')
  end
  lines
end
def read_programs
  programs = []
  File.foreach('input/program.src', encoding: 'ASCII').with_index(1) do |raw, number|
    line = raw.chomp
    if line.start_with?('#program ')
      programs << Program.new(line.delete_prefix('#program '))
    else
      programs.last.lines << [number, line]
    end
  end
  by_name = programs.to_h { |program| [program.name, program] }
  current = nil
  File.foreach('input/input.txt', encoding: 'ASCII') do |raw|
    line = raw.chomp
    if line.start_with?('#input ')
      current = by_name.fetch(line.delete_prefix('#input '))
    else
      current.inputs.concat(line.split(' ').map(&:to_i))
    end
  end
  programs
end
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  programs = read_programs
  reports = REPORTS.to_h { |name| [name, []] }
  programs.each do |program|
    program.compile
    reports.each_value { |lines| lines << "== program #{program.name} ==" }
    reports['diagnostics.txt'].concat(diagnostics(program))
    if program.error
      reports['listing.txt'] << 'not compiled'
      reports['stats.txt'] << 'not compiled'
    else
      reports['listing.txt'].concat(listing(program))
      reports['output.txt'].concat(program.execution.output)
      reports['stats.txt'].concat(statistics(program))
    end
  end
  reports['stats.txt'].concat(summary(programs))
  reports.each { |name, lines| File.write(File.join('output', name), lines.join("\n") + "\n") }
end

class Node
  attr_accessor :kind, :position, :type, :name, :name_position, :parameters, :body,
                :size, :size_position, :initializer, :statements, :end_position,
                :condition, :then_branch, :otherwise, :initial, :update, :value,
                :arguments, :expression, :index, :operator, :operand, :left, :right,
                :referent, :references, :read_accesses, :calls, :slot, :address, :completes
  def initialize(kind, position, **fields)
    @kind, @position = kind, position
    fields.each { |name, value| public_send("#{name}=", value) }
  end
end
module Tree
  module_function
  def expression_children(node)
    case node.kind
    when 'binary' then [node.left, node.right]
    when 'unary' then [node.operand]
    when 'array' then [node.index]
    when 'call' then node.arguments
    else []
    end
  end
  def statement_children(node)
    case node.kind
    when 'block' then node.statements
    when 'if' then [node.then_branch, node.otherwise].compact
    when 'while' then [node.body]
    when 'for' then [node.initial, node.update, node.body].compact
    else []
    end
  end
end
class Parser
  TYPES = %w[int bool void].freeze
  OPERATORS = [%w[||], %w[&&], %w[== !=], %w[< <= > >=], %w[+ -], %w[* / %]].freeze
  def initialize(tokens)
    @tokens, @index = tokens, 0
  end
  def peek = @tokens[@index]
  def fail_parse
    message = peek.kind == 'end' ? 'unexpected end of program' : "unexpected '#{peek.spelling}'"
    raise CompileError.new('syntax', peek.position, message)
  end
  def take
    token = peek
    @index += 1
    token
  end
  def accept(spelling) = peek.spelling == spelling ? take : nil
  def expect(spelling)
    fail_parse unless peek.spelling == spelling
    take
  end
  def identifier
    fail_parse unless peek.kind == 'identifier'
    take
  end
  def declaration_head
    fail_parse unless TYPES.include?(peek.spelling)
    type = take
    name = identifier
    [type.position, { type: type.spelling, name: name.spelling, name_position: name.position }]
  end
  def parse
    @jobs, @values = [], []
    descend(:program, [])
    @jobs.pop.call until @jobs.empty?
    @values.pop
  end
  def descend(rule, *arguments, &continuation)
    @jobs << -> { continuation.call(@values.pop) } if continuation
    @jobs << -> { public_send(rule, *arguments) }
  end
  def finish(value) = @values << value
  def program(declarations)
    return finish(declarations) if peek.kind == 'end'
    descend(:top_declaration) do |node|
      declarations << node
      descend(:program, declarations)
    end
  end
  def top_declaration
    position, fields = declaration_head
    if accept('(')
      parameters = []
      unless peek.spelling == ')'
        loop do
          parameter_position, parameter_fields = declaration_head
          parameters << Node.new('parameter', parameter_position, **parameter_fields)
          break unless accept(',')
        end
      end
      expect(')')
      descend(:block) { |body| finish(Node.new('function', position, **fields, parameters: parameters, body: body)) }
    elsif accept('[')
      fail_parse unless peek.kind == 'integer'
      token = take
      expect(']')
      expect(';')
      finish(Node.new('global', position, **fields, size: token.spelling.to_i, size_position: token.position))
    elsif accept('=')
      descend(:expression) do |initializer|
        expect(';')
        finish(Node.new('global', position, **fields, initializer: initializer))
      end
    else
      expect(';')
      finish(Node.new('global', position, **fields))
    end
  end
  def declaration(for_initial = false)
    position, fields = declaration_head
    initialized = for_initial ? expect('=') : accept('=')
    if initialized
      descend(:expression) do |initializer|
        expect(';') unless for_initial
        finish(Node.new('declaration', position, **fields, initializer: initializer))
      end
    else
      expect(';')
      finish(Node.new('declaration', position, **fields))
    end
  end
  def block
    opening = expect('{')
    descend(:block_contents, opening.position, [])
  end
  def block_contents(position, statements)
    if (closing = accept('}'))
      return finish(Node.new('block', position, statements: statements, end_position: closing.position))
    end
    descend(TYPES.include?(peek.spelling) ? :declaration : :statement) do |node|
      statements << node
      descend(:block_contents, position, statements)
    end
  end
  def statement
    token = peek
    case token.spelling
    when '{' then descend(:block)
    when 'if', 'while'
      take
      expect('(')
      descend(:expression) do |condition|
        expect(')')
        descend(:statement) do |body|
          if token.spelling == 'while'
            finish(Node.new('while', token.position, condition: condition, body: body))
          elsif accept('else')
            descend(:statement) do |otherwise|
              finish(Node.new('if', token.position, condition: condition, then_branch: body, otherwise: otherwise))
            end
          else
            finish(Node.new('if', token.position, condition: condition, then_branch: body))
          end
        end
      end
    when 'for'
      take
      expect('(')
      if TYPES.include?(peek.spelling)
        descend(:declaration, true) { |initial| descend(:for_condition, token.position, initial) }
      elsif peek.spelling != ';'
        descend(:simple) { |initial| descend(:for_condition, token.position, initial) }
      else
        descend(:for_condition, token.position, nil)
      end
    when 'break', 'continue'
      take
      expect(';')
      finish(Node.new(token.spelling, token.position))
    when 'return'
      take
      if accept(';')
        finish(Node.new('return', token.position))
      else
        descend(:expression) do |value|
          expect(';')
          finish(Node.new('return', token.position, value: value))
        end
      end
    when 'print'
      take
      expect('(')
      descend(:arguments, [], false) do |arguments|
        expect(';')
        finish(Node.new('print', token.position, arguments: arguments))
      end
    else
      fail_parse unless token.kind == 'identifier' || token.spelling == 'read'
      descend(:simple) do |result|
        expect(';')
        finish(result)
      end
    end
  end
  def for_condition(position, initial)
    expect(';')
    if peek.spelling == ';'
      descend(:for_update, position, initial, nil)
    else
      descend(:expression) { |condition| descend(:for_update, position, initial, condition) }
    end
  end
  def for_update(position, initial, condition)
    expect(';')
    if peek.spelling == ')'
      descend(:for_body, position, initial, condition, nil)
    else
      descend(:simple) { |update| descend(:for_body, position, initial, condition, update) }
    end
  end
  def for_body(position, initial, condition, update)
    expect(')')
    descend(:statement) { |body| finish(Node.new('for', position, initial: initial, condition: condition, update: update, body: body)) }
  end
  def simple
    fail_parse unless peek.kind == 'identifier' || peek.spelling == 'read'
    descend(:primary) do |value|
      if %w[call read].include?(value.kind)
        finish(Node.new('call_statement', value.position, expression: value))
      else
        expect('=')
        descend(:expression) do |right|
          finish(Node.new('assignment', value.position, name: value.name, index: value.index, value: right))
        end
      end
    end
  end
  def expression(level = 0)
    if level == OPERATORS.length
      if %w[- !].include?(peek.spelling)
        operator = take
        return descend(:expression, level) { |operand| finish(Node.new('unary', operator.position, operator: operator.spelling, operand: operand)) }
      end
      return descend(:primary)
    end
    descend(:expression, level + 1) { |result| descend(:binary_tail, level, result) }
  end
  def binary_tail(level, left)
    return finish(left) unless OPERATORS[level].include?(peek.spelling)
    operator = take
    descend(:expression, level + 1) do |right|
      descend(:binary_tail, level, Node.new('binary', operator.position, operator: operator.spelling, left: left, right: right))
    end
  end
  def primary
    token = peek
    if token.kind == 'integer'
      take
      return finish(Node.new('integer', token.position, value: token.spelling.to_i))
    elsif %w[true false].include?(token.spelling)
      take
      return finish(Node.new('boolean', token.position, value: token.spelling == 'true'))
    elsif accept('read')
      expect('(')
      expect(')')
      return finish(Node.new('read', token.position))
    elsif accept('(')
      return descend(:expression) do |result|
        expect(')')
        finish(result)
      end
    elsif token.kind == 'identifier'
      take
      if accept('(')
        return descend(:arguments, [], true) { |arguments| finish(Node.new('call', token.position, name: token.spelling, arguments: arguments)) }
      elsif accept('[')
        return descend(:expression) do |index|
          expect(']')
          finish(Node.new('array', token.position, name: token.spelling, index: index))
        end
      end
      return finish(Node.new('variable', token.position, name: token.spelling))
    end
    fail_parse
  end
  def arguments(values, allow_empty)
    if allow_empty && accept(')')
      return finish(values)
    end
    descend(:expression) do |value|
      values << value
      if accept(',')
        descend(:arguments, values, false)
      else
        expect(')')
        finish(values)
      end
    end
  end
end

require 'set'

def can_complete?(node)
  pending = [[node, false]]
  until pending.empty?
    current, expanded = pending.pop
    next unless current.completes.nil?
    if expanded
      current.completes = if current.kind == 'block'
                            current.statements.all?(&:completes)
                          else
                            current.then_branch.completes || current.otherwise.completes
                          end
    elsif current.kind == 'block' || (current.kind == 'if' && current.otherwise)
      pending << [current, true]
      children = current.kind == 'block' ? current.statements : [current.then_branch, current.otherwise]
      children.reverse_each { |child| pending << [child, false] }
    else
      current.completes = !%w[return break continue].include?(current.kind)
    end
  end
  node.completes
end

class Analyzer
  attr_reader :globals, :functions, :variables
  def initialize(declarations, end_position)
    @declarations, @end_position = declarations, end_position
    @globals, @functions, @variables, @scopes = {}, [], [], []
  end
  def fail_at(position, message) = raise(CompileError.new('semantic', position, message))
  def prepare(node)
    node.references, node.read_accesses = [], 0
    if node.kind == 'function'
      node.calls = Set.new
      @functions << node
    else
      @variables << node
    end
  end
  def lookup(name, position, read: true)
    scope = @scopes.reverse.find { |table| table.key?(name) }
    referent = scope ? scope[name] : @globals[name]
    if referent
      referent.references << position
      referent.read_accesses += 1 if read
    end
    referent
  end
  def variable(name, position, indexed, read: true)
    referent = lookup(name, position, read: read)
    fail_at(position, "undeclared identifier '#{name}'") unless referent
    fail_at(position, "'#{name}' is a function, not a variable") if referent.kind == 'function'
    array = referent.kind == 'global' && !referent.size.nil?
    fail_at(position, "'#{name}' is not an array") if indexed && !array
    fail_at(position, "array '#{name}' used without index") if !indexed && array
    referent
  end
  def expression(node, call_statement: false)
    pending = [[:visit, node, call_statement]]
    until pending.empty?
      action, current, detail = pending.pop
      if action == :argument
        argument, parameter, number = detail
        if argument.type != parameter.type
          fail_at(current.position, "argument #{number} of '#{current.name}' must be #{parameter.type}")
        end
      elsif action == :finish
        finish_expression(current, detail)
      else
        case current.kind
        when 'integer', 'read' then current.type = 'int'
        when 'boolean' then current.type = 'bool'
        when 'variable', 'array'
          current.referent = variable(current.name, current.position, current.kind == 'array')
          if current.kind == 'array'
            pending << [:finish, current]
            pending << [:visit, current.index, false]
          else
            current.type = current.referent.type
          end
        when 'call'
          referent = lookup(current.name, current.position)
          fail_at(current.position, "undeclared function '#{current.name}'") unless referent
          fail_at(current.position, "'#{current.name}' is not a function") unless referent.kind == 'function'
          current.referent = referent
          @function.calls << referent
          expected, found = referent.parameters.length, current.arguments.length
          if expected != found
            fail_at(current.position, "wrong number of arguments to '#{current.name}' (expected #{expected}, found #{found})")
          end
          pending << [:finish, current, detail]
          (found - 1).downto(0) do |index|
            argument = current.arguments[index]
            pending << [:argument, current, [argument, referent.parameters[index], index + 1]]
            pending << [:visit, argument, false]
          end
        when 'unary', 'binary'
          pending << [:finish, current]
          Tree.expression_children(current).reverse_each { |child| pending << [:visit, child, false] }
        end
      end
    end
    node.type
  end
  def finish_expression(node, call_statement)
    node.type = case node.kind
                when 'array'
                  fail_at(node.position, "index of '#{node.name}' must be int") unless node.index.type == 'int'
                  node.referent.type
                when 'call'
                  if !call_statement && node.referent.type == 'void'
                    fail_at(node.position, "void function '#{node.name}' used as a value")
                  end
                  node.referent.type
                when 'unary'
                  required = node.operator == '-' ? 'int' : 'bool'
                  fail_at(node.position, "operator '#{node.operator}' requires #{required} operand") unless node.operand.type == required
                  node.operand.type
                when 'binary'
                  left, right, operator = node.left.type, node.right.type, node.operator
                  if %w[+ - * / % < <= > >=].include?(operator)
                    fail_at(node.position, "operator '#{operator}' requires int operands") unless left == 'int' && right == 'int'
                    %w[+ - * / %].include?(operator) ? 'int' : 'bool'
                  elsif %w[== !=].include?(operator)
                    fail_at(node.position, "operator '#{operator}' requires operands of the same type") unless left == right
                    'bool'
                  else
                    fail_at(node.position, "operator '#{operator}' requires bool operands") unless left == 'bool' && right == 'bool'
                    'bool'
                  end
                end
  end
  def constant_initializer(node)
    positions, pending = [], [node]
    until pending.empty?
      current = pending.pop
      positions << current.position if %w[variable array call read].include?(current.kind)
      pending.concat(Tree.expression_children(current))
    end
    fail_at(positions.min, 'global initializer must be constant') unless positions.empty?
    expression(node)
  end
  def statement(node, loop_depth = 0)
    pending = [[node, loop_depth]]
    until pending.empty?
      current, depth = pending.pop
      if current == :close_scope
        @scopes.pop
      elsif current == :for_condition
        if depth.condition && expression(depth.condition) != 'bool'
          fail_at(depth.position, "condition of 'for' must be bool")
        end
      else
        check_statement(current, depth, pending)
      end
    end
  end
  def check_statement(node, loop_depth, pending)
    case node.kind
    when 'declaration'
      fail_at(node.name_position, "variable '#{node.name}' cannot have type void") if node.type == 'void'
      fail_at(node.name_position, "redeclaration of '#{node.name}'") if @scopes.last.key?(node.name)
      if node.initializer && expression(node.initializer) != node.type
        fail_at(node.name_position, "type mismatch in initialization of '#{node.name}'")
      end
      prepare(node)
      @scopes.last[node.name] = node
    when 'assignment'
      node.referent = variable(node.name, node.position, !node.index.nil?, read: false)
      fail_at(node.position, "index of '#{node.name}' must be int") if node.index && expression(node.index) != 'int'
      if expression(node.value) != node.referent.type
        fail_at(node.position, "type mismatch in assignment to '#{node.name}'")
      end
    when 'call_statement' then expression(node.expression, call_statement: true)
    when 'if', 'while'
      fail_at(node.position, "condition of '#{node.kind}' must be bool") unless expression(node.condition) == 'bool'
      if node.kind == 'if'
        pending << [node.otherwise, loop_depth] if node.otherwise
        pending << [node.then_branch, loop_depth]
      else
        pending << [node.body, loop_depth + 1]
      end
    when 'for'
      @scopes << {}
      pending << [:close_scope]
      pending << [node.body, loop_depth + 1]
      pending << [node.update, loop_depth] if node.update
      pending << [:for_condition, node]
      pending << [node.initial, loop_depth] if node.initial
    when 'break', 'continue'
      fail_at(node.position, "'#{node.kind}' outside loop") if loop_depth.zero?
    when 'return'
      if @function.type == 'void'
        fail_at(node.position, "function '#{@function.name}' must not return a value") if node.value
      else
        fail_at(node.position, "function '#{@function.name}' must return a value") unless node.value
        if expression(node.value) != @function.type
          fail_at(node.position, "return value of '#{@function.name}' must be #{@function.type}")
        end
      end
    when 'print'
      node.arguments.each_with_index do |argument, index|
        fail_at(node.position, "argument #{index + 1} of 'print' must be int") unless expression(argument) == 'int'
      end
    when 'block'
      @scopes << {}
      pending << [:close_scope]
      node.statements.reverse_each { |child| pending << [child, loop_depth] }
    end
  end
  def analyze
    @declarations.each do |node|
      if node.kind == 'global'
        if node.size
          fail_at(node.name_position, "array '#{node.name}' must have element type int") unless node.type == 'int'
          fail_at(node.size_position, "array '#{node.name}' must have a positive size") if node.size.zero?
        elsif node.type == 'void'
          fail_at(node.name_position, "variable '#{node.name}' cannot have type void")
        end
      end
      fail_at(node.name_position, "redeclaration of '#{node.name}'") if @globals.key?(node.name)
      if node.kind == 'global'
        if node.initializer && constant_initializer(node.initializer) != node.type
          fail_at(node.name_position, "type mismatch in initialization of '#{node.name}'")
        end
      else
        names = Set.new
        node.parameters.each do |parameter|
          fail_at(parameter.name_position, "parameter '#{parameter.name}' cannot have type void") if parameter.type == 'void'
          fail_at(parameter.name_position, "redeclaration of '#{parameter.name}'") if names.include?(parameter.name)
          names << parameter.name
          prepare(parameter)
        end
      end
      prepare(node)
      @globals[node.name] = node
    end
    main = @globals['main']
    fail_at(@end_position, 'no main function') unless main && main.kind == 'function'
    unless main.type == 'void' && main.parameters.empty?
      fail_at(main.name_position, "main must be declared as 'void main()'")
    end
    @functions.each do |function|
      @function = function
      @scopes = [function.parameters.to_h { |parameter| [parameter.name, parameter] }]
      function.body.statements.each { |node| statement(node) }
      if function.type != 'void' && can_complete?(function.body)
        fail_at(function.name_position, "missing return in function '#{function.name}'")
      end
    end
    self
  end
end

class RuntimeFault < StandardError; end
Frame = Struct.new(:locals, :return_address)
module IntegerOperations
  BINARY = %w[ADD SUB MUL DIV MOD LT LE GT GE EQ NE].freeze
  module_function
  def trunc_div(a, b)
    quotient = a.abs / b.abs
    a.negative? != b.negative? ? -quotient : quotient
  end
  def calculate(op, a, b = nil)
    raise RuntimeFault, 'division by zero' if %w[DIV MOD].include?(op) && b.zero?
    result = case op
             when 'ADD' then a + b
             when 'SUB' then a - b
             when 'MUL' then a * b
             when 'DIV' then trunc_div(a, b)
             when 'MOD' then a - trunc_div(a, b) * b
             when 'NEG' then -a
             when 'NOT' then a.zero? ? 1 : 0
             when 'LT' then a < b ? 1 : 0
             when 'LE' then a <= b ? 1 : 0
             when 'GT' then a > b ? 1 : 0
             when 'GE' then a >= b ? 1 : 0
             when 'EQ' then a == b ? 1 : 0
             when 'NE' then a != b ? 1 : 0
             end
    raise RuntimeFault, 'integer overflow' unless (-2_147_483_648..2_147_483_647).cover?(result)
    result
  end
end

class Execution
  attr_reader :executed, :counts, :calls, :pairs, :max_stack, :max_depth, :output, :error, :error_pc, :frames
  def initialize(code, owners, starts, global_size, inputs)
    @code, @owners, @starts, @inputs = code, owners, starts, inputs
    @globals = Array.new(global_size, 0)
    @stack, @frames, @output = [], [], []
    @read_position = @pc = @executed = @max_stack = @max_depth = 0
    @counts = Array.new(code.length, 0)
    @calls, @pairs = Hash.new(0), Hash.new(0)
    @error = @error_pc = nil
  end
  def step
    instruction = @code[@pc]
    op, args = instruction.op, instruction.args
    next_pc = @pc + 1
    case op
    when 'PUSH' then @stack << args[0]
    when 'POP' then @stack.pop
    when 'LOADG' then @stack << @globals[args[0]]
    when 'STOREG' then @globals[args[0]] = @stack.pop
    when 'LOADL' then @stack << @frames.last.locals[args[0]]
    when 'STOREL' then @frames.last.locals[args[0]] = @stack.pop
    when 'LOADA', 'STOREA'
      value = @stack.pop if op == 'STOREA'
      index = @stack.pop
      address, size = args
      if index.negative? || index >= size
        raise RuntimeFault, "index #{index} out of bounds for array of size #{size}"
      end
      if op == 'LOADA'
        @stack << @globals[address + index]
      else
        @globals[address + index] = value
      end
    when *IntegerOperations::BINARY
      b, a = @stack.pop, @stack.pop
      @stack << IntegerOperations.calculate(op, a, b)
    when 'NEG', 'NOT' then @stack << IntegerOperations.calculate(op, @stack.pop)
    when 'JUMP' then next_pc = args[0]
    when 'JUMPF', 'JUMPT'
      next_pc = args[0] if @stack.pop.zero? == (op == 'JUMPF')
    when 'CALL'
      raise RuntimeFault, 'call depth limit exceeded' if @frames.length == 100
      target, count = args
      @frames << Frame.new(@stack.pop(count), next_pc)
      callee = @starts.fetch(target)
      @calls[callee] += 1
      @pairs[[@owners[@pc], callee]] += 1
      next_pc = target
    when 'ENTER'
      locals = @frames.last.locals
      locals.concat(Array.new(args[0] - locals.length, 0))
    when 'RET', 'RETV' then next_pc = @frames.pop.return_address
    when 'READ'
      raise RuntimeFault, 'read past end of input' if @read_position == @inputs.length
      @stack << @inputs[@read_position]
      @read_position += 1
    when 'PRINT' then @output << @stack.pop(args[0]).join(' ')
    end
    @max_stack = [@max_stack, @stack.length].max
    @max_depth = [@max_depth, @frames.length].max
    @pc = next_pc
    op != 'HALT'
  end
  def run
    loop do
      if @executed == 100_000
        @error, @error_pc = 'instruction limit exceeded', @pc
        break
      end
      @executed += 1
      @counts[@pc] += 1
      begin
        break unless step
      rescue RuntimeFault => error
        @error, @error_pc = error.message, @pc
        break
      end
    end
    self
  end
end
